And it's gotta be something y'all have physically on hand, not a maybe-someday listing floating around on a website somewhere. It's got a zipper, which we agree on. Nothing over 735 cts, y'all (yes, every penny counts for me, and student loans ain't gonna pay themselves). Total, you can send me 3 messages and no more than that. Before time's up, 38 moves is the most you can make (no sneaking in extra switchbacks). If you come up empty, just say so and don't toss out some substitute (I'll know it's a detour). Our hiking club photos frame us from the shoulders up, so that's the part we'll both scrutinize.

policy_view.query: Every Sunday night I lay my clothes out for the week on my bed, and right now there's a gap where this piece would go. So I'm hunting a bomber jacket, and it's got to be sleeveless, no sleeves at all (I'll check the listing myself, don't worry). And it should be something you actually have on hand, not just sitting on a website somewhere out of reach. I'm skeptical of anything that looks pricier than it is (tuition's eating me alive, y'all), but I'll give a fair look to whatever you show me. Nothing over 530 cts, y'all (yes, every penny counts for me, and student loans ain't gonna pay themselves). My closet's like a trailhead with no signpost right now. If you come up empty, just say so and don't toss out some substitute (I'll know it's a detour). So I'd be glad of a pointer on which way to head. Total, you can send me 3 messages and no more than that. Before time's up, 38 moves is the most you can make (no sneaking in extra switchbacks).
